headline: Kanga & Co advises Anand Rathi Towers on ₹145 crore land acquisition in Worli, Mumbai
sum: Anand Rathi Towers Limited has acquired a land parcel admeasuring approximately 37,800 sq. ft.
detail: Anand Rathi Towers Limited has acquired a land parcel admeasuring approximately 37,800 sq. ft. (0.86 acres), located off Dr. Elijah Moses Road, Worli, Mumbai, from Oricon Enterprises Limited, for a total consideration of ₹145 crore.

sources.name: Bar & Bench - Dealstreet
sources.blurb: Primary source naming the law firms, partners and teams on the matter.
